text: Describe the last-minute preparation and the moment before revealing a surprise party for a friend
or relative, and their reaction when it is revealed.
OR
Imagine you are stuck in a lift or elevator for a few minutes. Describe the other people in the lift or
elevator and their reactions, as well as your own.
OR
Narrative Writing
Write a story which involves a visit to relatives.
